origin: Dick Johnson Racing emerged from humble beginnings in the late 1970s, fueled by the sheer determination of Dick Johnson himself. Starting as a privateer, Johnson campaigned a succession of underfunded but meticulously prepared Ford Falcons against the might of factory-backed teams. The pivotal moment came at Bathurst in 1980 when, leading the race, Johnson collided with a rock dislodged by a spectator. The public outcry and subsequent fundraising efforts by Channel 7 and the Australian public allowed Johnson to rebuild and continue racing, cementing his status as a народный герой (people's hero). This incident sparked a fierce national pride in the team, transforming them from a small operation into a beloved racing icon.
philosophy: DJR's philosophy has always been rooted in hard work, resilience, and a 'never give up' attitude. Car development focused on incremental improvements and reliability, often prioritizing finishing races over outright speed. The team culture is characterized by a strong family atmosphere, with loyalty and dedication valued above all else. The team always has a strong connection with Ford and has had long relationships with its drivers and employees.

teamPrincipal.name: Dick Johnson
teamPrincipal.background: Dick Johnson is an Australian racing legend, known for his aggressive driving style and unwavering dedication. He instilled a strong work ethic and a passion for racing throughout the entire team, leading by example both on and off the track.

keyFigures.name: Neal Lowe
keyFigures.description: Lowe was Johnson's right-hand man for many years, known for his meticulous attention to detail and unwavering loyalty. He was instrumental in preparing the cars that delivered DJR's early successes.

headquarters: The team is based in Stapylton, Queensland, Australia. The facilities are relatively basic, reflecting the team's grounded origins and focus on practical engineering rather than lavish infrastructure.
fanBase: DJR boasts a fiercely loyal and passionate fanbase, drawn to the team's underdog spirit and Johnson's down-to-earth personality. They are considered the quintessential Australian racing team, representing the battler spirit and a strong connection to the Ford brand. The fans are known for their unwavering support, often sporting Ford memorabilia and attending races in large numbers.
